Latin word

īnstō

īnstō, īnstāre, īnstitī, īnstātum

verb, first conjugation; with an accusative and infinitive, or the dative of the person pressed

insist, press (a point); press, insist, keep at (someone)

In this lexicon

  • emphasize

    also used · classical · Ter. And. 147: ille īnstat factum; Cic. Att. 13.32.1 (Lewis & Short): urgē, īnstā, perfice

  • pressure

    also used · classical · Cic. Att. 1.13.3: īnstat et urget Catō; Cic. Att. 13.32.1: urgē, īnstā, perfice (Lewis & Short); Traupman 364
